title: 電子回路
subtitle: Electronic Circuit
educationalGoal: (1)Learn digital and analog circuits. (2)Learn interfaces between computers and machines. (3)Understand how various kinds of electronic circuits work.
advice: This is the second fundamental course in electronic circuits. We will mainly cover the following topics: 1.Digital circuits and their applications 2.Interfaces between computers and machines 3.Analog circuits Students are expected to actively participate in class. Students are expected to complete exercises independently. Students are required to be aware of the instructor’s messages in the class and to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class because the course schedule may change depending on the class progress.
requiredKnowledge: Completion of Mathematics for Electric Circuit I, and Electric Circuit II.

activityGoals.body: Explain how a digital circuit works.
Explain a stepping motor, a DC motor, and an interface between a computer and a machine.
Explain how an analog circuit works.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1)Explain how a digital circuit works. (2)Explain a stepping motor, a DC motor, and an interface between a computer and a machine. (3)Explain how an analog circuit with at least one operational amplifier works.
achievementLevels.standard: (1)Explain how a simple digital circuit works. (2)Explain DC motor control with pulse-width modulation (PWM). (3)Explain how a simple analog circuit with one operational amplifier works.

lessons.content: Textbook Chapter 3, "The basics of digital circuits" - NAND and NOR gates - Equivalent circuits using NAND gates - ExOR and EXNOR gates
lessons.assignments: Read and understand the indicated textbook sections

lessons.content: Textbook Chapter 4, "The basics of digital ICs" - Types of digital integrated circuits (ICs) - Power supplies and grounds - Basics of transistor-transistor logic (TTL)
lessons.assignments: Read and understand the indicated textbook sections

lessons.content: Textbook Chapter 4, "The basics of digital ICs" - Basics of TTL - CMOS ICs - Interfaces between CMOS and TTL ICs
